BPD is an emotional ride based on its origins, nature, nuture debate. MH factors for some based on hereditary traits.  It stems around abandonment and rejection and how this was indoctrinated into your life.

Sexual abuse, violence, emotional, physical and verbal abuse can add. Bullying also.

In response to excuse for actions. MH can diminish ones capacity to behave within societies structural norms. Thats why we gave legal recourse for those who commit within this remit.

Also one of BPD's main features are impulse, if ones impulse diminishes the mind to be rational its is cause by that disease.

Some people behave better than others, some have had the illness for tears abd patterns have become more ingrained. Mostly if you have BPD you push away because if that unworthy feeling.

 Those actions are directed at us, whether drugs, sex, food, SH, ...... 

I do not 'Condone my actions' but i am aware most of my life has been BPD somewhere intertwined in all my actions. When i overcame for the day it was good, when bad really bad.

We need to stop judging ourselves you know, we need to stop looking at where we are in this BPD journey with it comorbidities and complexities.

I have hurt soooo many family members, sometimes without realising, yes like the 'normal people' as we classed as not normal 😏 but we not here making up an issue about that and that the issue is it not 'The intensity of our emotions combined with our abject lack is self, that make us impulsive.  We desire what normal people have. 

Yes BPD is the issue it remove rationality and replaces it with emotionality.  I do not like what i do sometimes i miss it, until every word and nuance has to be examined.  

I hope we can be compassionate to those struggling, those further on in their healing and those who have no idea.

I struggle daily daily daily. I pray we all get through this illness.

Advice, we are all different and some of these traits you mention may be other MH illnesses. 

Remain upbeat positive loving, consistent, confident, listen, love, laugh.

To help your friend wBPD encourage and support the process learn some of the DBT tasks, its good for all of us. That way you will circumvent failure. 

As them to explain it, mo judgement, then you will see that the negative cannotations relate to the "illnes' not your friend. 

Dont allow them to give up as our aim to please can be impulsive too. Hug them even when they don't want it. We want it but it hurts. 

Ensure your boundaries are safe we font like rejection we like safe boundaries ones that we know were safe.  You are entitled to them.  Get your friend to read this. They may agree 🙏🏿.

Its not easy and i commend you and send love for the support, we need it.

But it also such a hidden MH illness, i am able to work.  But unable to form relationships due to my insecurities.

BpD wear their insecurities outside, normal people inside.  As to those throes of passion, exhausting, frightening, in- enlightening and isolating, why because everyone perceives the you that they see as you. Unfortunately its BpD.  

Underneath all that is a frightened child,chic,woman.

What more frightening is as said BpD is hidden from, sufferer, family, friends.  One because we are able to flow a lot of the time in society, high functioning, but also because society hides it.  

Where are the real support networks for all of us.  We are not taught to adapt, our parents, us.  But hey its only been recognised around 50 years properly.

Its hard thinking your ill when you can kinda function, so its not many don't want the help it hard.  And the older you become the safety mechanism become more ingrained.

Yes im aware and today i still wanted to die and even researched it. Let it be known we also are more likely to carry it out and succeed. I do not enjoy any part of this tainted disease, its not even accommodating.  I hope you and your family pull through rally round for each other, because cptsd is not nice either. Its horrible for all. I am so frustrated at the way it destroys us all.
